method: Read current code and setting documents; visually inspected all 16 main compositions and representative detailed states; checked corrections with source and final images. Differences assessed by information structure and navigation, not only file hashes.

arena: A top horizontal status broadcast cards
C world left, shared right status/control tower
D bottom dual character docks with top controls
storage: A individual list with in-place details
B species grid plus individual selector and attribute drawer
C two-page field guide with individual index
D horizontal individual gallery with bottom attribute drawer
hatch: C parent relationship graph around offspring preview
D mother dossier with inheritance checklist and confirmation ticket
story: B two-page book and page tabs
D archive list and scene preview

coverage.storage: 20 fixed example individuals plus local hatchlings distinguished; gender and individual selection retained; six attributes by four data columns, current/other traits and selected/remaining skills covered in main/detail states. No deployment or training actions added.
coverage.hatch: Mother and father readable full details; missing-parent state without hatch action; offspring Lv0 separate from skill rank; only tied mother maximum allows identity choice; inclusive parent-highest rank range and conditional 1% breakthrough; second identity excludes first, rank weights9..1; local save success/failure distinction; pre-hatch preview has no fabricated random output; four added result pages use an explicitly labelled artificial child example, not a real hatch or save.
coverage.story: Layout/navigation suggestions remain placeholders, no approved chapters, rewards, energy, progress or gameplay rules.
coverage.arena: Read-only automatic skills; existing controls retained; fixed sample HP110/120 and120/120, CD3.8/7.8 and1.8/4.8, sheep charge17.5; world700x600 at equal aspect; sample not captured gameplay.
